findings.title: No picture of a boat or the canal anywhere on the page

location.description: the hero, and the whole page at every viewport

findings.viewer_experience: Nothing shows the visitor a boat, a lock or a towpath, so nothing makes them want to go, and the page reads as a form with a headline.
findings.target: real photos of the actual boats or routes set into the hero
findings.fix_direction: Set real photos of the actual boats or routes into the hero. On desktop and widescreen, use the empty band below the routes, or put a photo beside or behind the headline. The maker must supply the photos. Do not use stock images.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees a real photo of a boat or the canal in the hero in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: The headline is weight 400 and the same color as the lead
findings.viewer_experience: The headline gets no extra step over the lead, though by eye it leads anyway.

current.value: weight 400, contrast 12.75:1, same as the lead

findings.target: a heavier weight than the lead
findings.fix_direction: A semibold weight of the serif would give the headline the extra step.

closed_when.check: font_weight of h1 in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports is above 400

findings.title: The Start date field shows plain text with no year and no picker

location.description: the Start date field in the Find a boat card

findings.viewer_experience: It shows "Sat 14 June" with no year and no picker.

current.value: "Sat 14 June" as plain text, no year, no picker

findings.target: a date input that shows the year
findings.fix_direction: Use a date input that shows the year.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees the Start date field show a date with the year in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: The nav does not mark the current page
findings.viewer_experience: No nav item has a cue for the current page.

current.value: no cue on any nav item

findings.target: one cue on the active item
findings.fix_direction: Give the active item one cue, such as an underline or a heavier weight.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees one nav item marked as current in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: On the tablet the content column ends before the nav does

location.description: the right edge of the content column and of the nav on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The right margins of the column and the nav do not line up.

current.value: column ends at x 664, nav ends at x 704

findings.target: the column and the nav end at the same right margin
findings.fix_direction: Let the column fill to the same right margin, or align the nav with the column.

closed_when.check: the right edge of the content column and of nav.site-nav > a:nth-of-type(4) in the tablet viewport are the same x
